data.scope: same compiled bundle and input, correctness diagnostic, not formal timing or physical ANE proof
data.inference_limit: Policy/path-dependent numerical observation on this bundle; no isolated op or physical-device cause proved.

prediction_host_seconds.scope: public prediction + actual output copy, not per-op device time

post_prediction_restore_join_host_second.scope: includes any exposed GPU tail wait

vs_fp32_same_fp16_source.scope: whole output against FP32 MLX reference

vs_independent_fp64_witness.scope: sampled rows/columns, all reduction channels, CPU FP64 einsum

vs_original_bf16_replica.scope: whole output against original BF16 compiled GPU replica, not request quality

compute_plan.scope: anticipated device/cost, null costs retained in raw plan

host_events.scope: CPU host timestamps only, never GPU/ANE hardware timestamps

limitations: Only layer0 real activations replayed so far; 3 depths were captured.
Resident weights/interfaces; no weight streaming or LoRA qualification.
No global cache purge, PMU, Xcode capture or physical overlap proof.
The initial CPU-only diagnostic failed during conversion for disk space; a later retry and same-bundle policy diagnostic must be interpreted separately.
Initial runs had low disk headroom; post-cleanup runs record explicit disk admission.
Raw capture wall time is instrumented, not a normal request benchmark.
Original fixture weights, inputs and full reports stay local; no media or weights embedded here.

data.scope: supplemental same-host hardware inspection after initial cases; no serial/UUID captured
data.collector: system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType -json, filtered before output to sppci_model and sppci_cores; sysctl hw.memsize
